At Five Below our growth is a result of the people who embrace our purpose: We know life is way better when you are free to Let Go & Have Fun in an amazing experience, filled with unlimited possibilities, priced so low, you can always say yes to the newest, coolest stuff! Just ask any of our over 35,000 crew members who work at Five Below and they’ll tell you there’s no other place like it. It all starts with our purpose and then, The Five Below Way, which is our values and behaviors that each and every crew member believes in.

It’s all about culture at Five Below, making this a place that can inspire you as much as you inspire us with big ideas, super energy, passion, and the ability to make the workplace a WOWplace!

**Location:** Ship Center New Jersey, Hybrid

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Manager Inbound Logistics, this position is responsible for managing and optimizing end‑to‑end domestic transportation activities across multiple modes (truckload, LTL, intermodal, parcel, and dedicated fleets). This role serves as a senior subject‑matter expert, ensuring freight moves efficiently, cost‑effectively, and in compliance with service, safety, and regulatory requirements. The position works cross‑functionally with operations, procurement, customer service, and carriers to drive performance, resolve complex issues, and support continuous improvement initiatives

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Transportation, Business, (or equivalent experience)
* 5–8+ years of experience in domestic transportation or logistics operations
* Strong knowledge of U.S. domestic freight modes and carrier operations
* Hands‑on experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret freight data and KPIs
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
* Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and stakeholder management skills
* Proficient in using transportation management systems (Manhattan TMS preferred) and related software.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Problem-solving skills to address issues related to shipments and transportation.
* Negotiation skills for contract management with carriers and service providers.
* Microsoft Office products (i.e. Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access, etc.)

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Inbound Transportation Management**

* Coordinate and manage domestic inbound freight movements from suppliers, vendors, and transload facilities to distribution centers.
* Plan and optimize transportation capacity across truckload (TL), less-than-truckload (LTL), intermodal, and rail networks.
* Monitor shipment status and proactively address transit delays, service disruptions, and exceptions.
* Ensure timely delivery of inventory to support distribution center and store replenishment requirements.

**Carrier Management**

* Build and maintain relationships with transportation providers and third-party logistics (3PL) partners.
* Monitor carrier performance through KPIs including on-time pickup, on-time delivery, tender acceptance, and claims ratios.
* Participate in carrier sourcing events, RFPs, and rate negotiations.
* Support carrier compliance with routing guides, service requirements, and operational expectations.
* Primary contact for carrier onboarding/operational readiness

**Vendor Compliance & Collaboration**

* Partner with suppliers to ensure compliance with routing instructions, shipping requirements, and appointment scheduling processes.
* Resolve vendor shipping issues impacting inventory flow or transportation costs.
* Drive improvements in supplier shipping performance and compliance metrics.

**Capacity Planning & Network Optimization**

* Analyze freight forecasts and inventory flow to secure transportation capacity during peak and seasonal periods.
* Collaborate with merchants, inventory planning, replenishment, and distribution center teams to align transportation resources with business demand.
* Identify opportunities to improve load utilization, reduce empty miles, and increase transportation efficiency.

**Operational Execution**

* Manage daily transportation execution activities, including freight tendering, load planning, appointment scheduling, and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate inbound delivery appointments with distribution centers and terminals.
* Escalate and resolve service failures affecting inventory availability or distribution center operations.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain transportation performance dashboards and scorecards.
* Analyze transportation spend, service metrics, freight trends, and network performance.
* Communicate operational performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership.
* Utilize TMS, and reporting tools to support decision-making.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify cost-saving and productivity improvement opportunities across the inbound transportation network.
* Lead and support transportation initiatives related to process standardization, automation, and network optimization.
* Develop and maintain SOPs and best practices for inbound transportation operations.
* Participate in cross-functional projects supporting supply chain and logistics transformation initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with Distribution Center Operations, Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and Procurement teams.
* Coordinate transportation support for new store openings, DC transitions, seasonal sets, and network changes.
* Ensure alignment between transportation execution and broader supply chain objectives.

**Typical KPIs**

* On-Time Pickup %
* On-Time Delivery %
* Carrier Tender Acceptance %
* Transportation Cost per Unit/Case
* Load Fill/Density Utilization
* Vendor Compliance %
* Transit Time Performance
* Claims and Damage Rates
* Inbound Appointment Compliance
* Freight Cost Savings and Avoidance

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Serve as a subject matter expert for inbound transportation operations.
* Mentor and train logistics specialists and coordinators.
* Lead issue resolution efforts during transportation disruptions and peak shipping periods.
* Present transportation performance, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**  
  
We are seeking a mid-level Recruiter to help Vestwell expand by hiring top-notch Operations, Services, and G&A roles in our New York or King of Prussia office. In this role, you'll partner with leadership teams to determine recruitment needs and develop hiring strategies. You'll own search strategy and sourcing approach, advise hiring managers on market conditions, compensation, and selection decisions, and negotiate and extend offers to candidates. You will also ensure data integrity in Rippling (our HRIS) and Greenhouse (our ATS) and advise and influence hiring teams in making objective hiring decisions. To ensure success, the Recruiter should have a demonstrable track record in hiring talented candidates across business functions. Outstanding recruiters study metrics to track recruitment successes and identify opportunities for improvement in the hiring process.  
  
**What Will You Be Doing?**  
  
Day-to-day you will be expected to:

* Own full-cycle recruiting for entry to Senior Manager level Operations, Services, and G&A roles.
* Develop and implement hiring strategies in consultation with hiring managers, advising them on market conditions, compensation, and selection decisions.
* Determine the audience, method, and reach of the hiring process for each search.
* Negotiate and extend offers to candidates.
* Develop recruitment marketing strategy and campaigns that position Vestwell as an employer of choice.
* Select and advertise positions via suitable recruitment platforms and networks.
* Ensure data integrity in Greenhouse and Rippling and use recruiting metrics to improve the hiring process.

**Requirements**

*The Necessities:*

* 2-3 years of full-cycle recruitment experience
* Experience working with internal and external clients with competing priorities and deadlines
* Excellent interpersonal communication and time management skills
* Strong social aptitude and ability to build relationships across functions and levels
* Industry knowledge to be able to talk to job prospects and understand qualifications
* Ability to quickly adapt to and learn new tools as needed; proactive in learning independently and applying to on-the-job scenarios
* Hunger and drive to grow into a talent acquisition expert for Vestwell
* Proficient in recruiting ATS platforms; preferably Greenhouse

*The Extras:*

* Internal and external negotiation skills
* Previous work experience in sales, research, operations, customer service, information technology, administration, schedule coordination, or other related jobs
* Experience with project and program management
* Experience working in startup and or FinTech environment(s)

This role will be based in our New York or King of Prussia office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

This role will be hired on a W-2, contract-to-hire basis of up to 3 months, with the potential to extend and/or convert to full-time employment.

The expected base salary range for this position is $70K - $85K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

**Location: Remote**

**Salary Range: $115,200 - $168,300**

  

**Formerly the Mental Health Association of New York City (MHA-NYC), Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high quality services and support, when, where and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state-of-the-art technology-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone.**

  

**Position Overview:**

The Director, Grant Management is responsible for coordinating federal grants, with particular responsibility for SAMHSA awards supporting the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. The Director oversees pre-award planning, organization, budget preparation, post-award administration, reporting, procurement, and closeout; ensures grants comply with funding-agency requirements, organizational policies, 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance), 2 CFR Part 300, and other applicable federal regulations; and aligns grant operations across Finance, Program, Operations, and executive leadership. The role supervises the Grants Manager and strengthens the systems, controls, and processes that support audit readiness and continuity of 988 services.

  

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all aspects of 988 federal grant management, including responses to funder requests, reporting, and tracking of grant deliverables.
* Lead coordination of pre-award planning, organization, and budget preparation, and the post-award administration and closeout of grants.
* Manage the grants team to ensure compliance with SAMHSA requirements, 2 CFR Part 200, 2 CFR Part 300, other applicable regulations, organizational policies, award terms, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee day-to-day business operations associated with 988 fiscal and grant activities, ensuring effective coordination across Finance, Operations, Program, and Grants Management teams to support operational efficiency, compliance, and continuity of services.
* Oversee the review, approval, and processing of invoices related to 988 federal grants, contracts, and vendor payments, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timely submission, appropriate supporting documentation, and compliance with SAMHSA requirements, Uniform Guidance, and organizational financial policies.
* Provide oversight of procurement and contract activities tied to federal grant funding, ensuring proper documentation and alignment with both federal and organizational policies.
* Oversee the preparation, coordination, and timely submission of required federal reports, including performance, progress, and financial reports, to SAMHSA.
* Partner with Finance, Operations, Program, and Grants Management teams to align grant strategy, manage budgets, and ensure compliance across departments.
* Review and approve financial reconciliations and reclassification requests related to 988 grants and operational expenditures, ensuring accuracy, appropriate allocation of costs, compliance with federal grant requirements, and alignment with organizational financial policies and reporting standards
* Maintain audit readiness by strengthening systems, controls, records, and supporting documentation and addressing compliance risks and corrective actions promptly.
* Serve as the primary liaison to SAMHSA’s Grants Management Specialist and the 988 Government Project Officer, as directed by the AVP, 988 Strategy and Grants Management.
* Meet weekly with the AVP, 988 Strategy and Grants Management, to provide updates, highlight strengths and progress, and identify critical gaps or risks.
* Translate high-level Lifeline/988 policy goals, award requirements, and strategic priorities into clear, actionable initiatives for direct reports.
* Partner with direct reports on performance management, regular developmental reviews, training, coaching, and clear accountability.
* Create mentorship and apprenticeship opportunities that support teammates in developing as leaders within Lifeline/988.
* Engage in professional development activities, including leadership and DEIB training.
Other duties as assigned  

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Skilled in managing relationships with federal funders and internal teams
* High emotional intelligence and professionalism in diverse stakeholder settings

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Strong time management, organization, and project prioritization skills

* Strategic thinker with effective delegation and decision-making skills

* Basic understanding of accounting and use of financial data

* Solution-focused approach to challenges and team leadership

* Interest or experience in mental health, suicide prevention, or the nonprofit sector preferred
* Outstanding written and verbal communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Master’s degree in healthcare, public health, policy, or a social science field, such as an MPH, MPA, MSW, or another health-related degree, preferred.
* 7+ years of progressively responsible professional experience managing federal grants, including substantial post-award compliance responsibility.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in a relevant field, including strategic planning, outreach and engagement, staff development, and cross-functional work.
* Experience managing relationships with federal funders and overseeing budgeting, reporting, procurement, and post-award compliance for federally funded programs.
  

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
* Will constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
* Will frequently communicate over video calls with internal and external stakeholders to provide status updates and potential roadblocks.

0899dab7acfec6e47fa2.title: Department Chair, Exercise Science and Program Director, Athletic Training, Jefferson College of Rehabilitation Sciences, Thomas Jefferson University
0899dab7acfec6e47fa2.description:
**Number of Positions In Requisition**

1



**Job Details**

Position Summary
  
  
Thomas Jefferson University invites applications and nominations for the combined position of Chair of the Department of Exercise Science and Program Director of the Athletic Training Program in the Jefferson College of Rehabilitation Sciences.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide strategic, academic, administrative, and operational leadership for the Department of Exercise Science while also directing the Commission on Accreditation of Athletic Training Education (CAATE)–accredited professional athletic training program. The individual will report to the Dean of the Jefferson College of Rehabilitation Sciences and will work collaboratively with faculty, staff, students, College and University leaders, clinical and community partners, and professional organizations.
  
  
As Department Chair, the successful candidate will serve as the Department’s chief academic and administrative leader, with responsibility for academic quality, faculty and staff development, strategic planning, enrollment, resource management, scholarship, student success, and program growth.
  
  
As Athletic Training Program Director, the successful candidate will provide direct leadership and oversight of the professional athletic training program and ensure that it meets institutional requirements and maintains continuous compliance with CAATE standards, policies, and reporting expectations.
  
  
The position includes a full-time faculty appointment at a rank and on a faculty track commensurate with the candidate’s academic preparation, professional accomplishments, leadership experience, and scholarly record.
  
  
Department Chair Responsibilities
  
  
Academic and Strategic Leadership
  
  
Provide visionary, collaborative, and inclusive leadership for the Department of Exercise Science.
  
  
Ensure curriculum, faculty qualifications, experiential learning, facilities, and student learning outcomes remain aligned with applicable professional standards.
  
  
Develop and implement a strategic direction aligned with the missions and priorities of the Department, College, and University.
  
  
Promote academic excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across the Department’s undergraduate, accelerated, and graduate educational pathways.
  
  
Guide the development, assessment, revision, and expansion of academic programs in response to student needs, workforce trends, professional developments, and emerging areas of exercise and health science.
  
  
Strengthen pathways connecting exercise science with athletic training and other rehabilitation and health professions.
  
  
Promote interdisciplinary and interprofessional collaboration across the College and University.
  
  
Represent the Department within the University and to external academic, clinical, professional, industry, and community constituencies.
  
  
Advance the Department’s visibility, reputation, enrollment, and regional and national impact.
  
  
Maintain active professional engagement in the relevant Exercise Science professional association(s)
  
  
Faculty and Staff Leadership
  
  
Recruit, retain, mentor, develop, and evaluate highly qualified faculty and staff.
  
  
Cultivate a collegial, respectful, inclusive, and accountable departmental culture.
  
  
Support faculty advancement in teaching, scholarship, clinical practice, service, and professional leadership.
  
  
Establish clear expectations and equitable workload assignments based on faculty roles, program requirements, and College policies.
  
  
Promote faculty development, leadership development, and succession planning.
  
  
Foster shared governance, transparent communication, and meaningful faculty and staff engagement.
  
  
Address personnel and performance concerns in a timely, constructive, and equitable manner.
  
  
Make recommendations regarding appointments, reappointments, promotion, recognition, and other personnel actions in accordance with University policies.
  
  
Program Quality and Student Success
  
  
Ensure the academic quality, coherence, relevance, and effectiveness of all programs within the Department.
  
  
Promote a culture of assessment in which student learning, program outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and operational data inform continuous improvement.
  
  
Monitor enrollment, retention, progression, graduation, certification-examination performance, employment, and other indicators of program effectiveness.
  
  
Collaborate with program leaders and University offices to support student recruitment, advising, persistence, professional development, and career preparation.
  
  
Promote an educational environment that supports student learning, belonging, well-being, professionalism, and success.
  
  
Support experiential education, internships, clinical education, research experiences, and community-engaged learning.
  
  
Work closely with the Coordinator of Clinical Education to ensure the quality, sufficiency, diversity, and effectiveness of clinical education experiences.
  
  
Ensure that academic policies and procedures are implemented consistently, transparently, and fairly.
  
  
Scholarship, Research, and Innovation
  
  
Foster a departmental culture that supports scholarship, inquiry, innovation, and dissemination.
  
  
Mentor and support faculty in establishing productive and sustainable programs of scholarship.
  
  
Promote interdisciplinary research involving exercise physiology, human performance, sports science, rehabilitation, injury prevention, wellness, and related fields.
  
  
Encourage external funding, industry collaboration, community-engaged scholarship, and translational research.
  
  
Advocate for appropriate research infrastructure, equipment, facilities, mentorship, and protected time.
  
  
Promote opportunities for student involvement in research, quality improvement, and scholarly dissemination.
  
  
Strengthen the visibility and impact of the Department’s scholarly contributions.
  
  
Administration and Resource Management
  
  
Oversee the Department’s academic, operational, personnel, financial, and facility-related affairs.
  
  
Develop and manage the departmental budget in alignment with strategic priorities and available resources.
  
  
Use enrollment, financial, outcomes, and workforce data to guide planning and resource allocation.
  
  
Advocate for the faculty, staff, facilities, laboratories, technology, equipment, and administrative support required to sustain academic quality and program growth.
  
  
Collaborate with College leadership regarding enrollment management, program development, space planning, and financial sustainability.
  
  
Ensure compliance with University policies, faculty governance processes, legal requirements, and ethical expectations.
  
  
Identify opportunities for partnerships, philanthropy, continuing education, grants, and responsible revenue diversification.
  
  
Athletic Training Program Director Responsibilities
  
  
Program Leadership and Administration
  
  
Provide leadership and administrative oversight for the professional athletic training program.
  
  
Ensure that the program’s mission, goals, curriculum, policies, practices, and outcomes align with institutional expectations and CAATE standards.
  
  
Maintain sufficient authority, time, and administrative support to manage the program effectively.
  
  
Coordinate program planning, implementation, evaluation, and continuous quality improvement.
  
  
Lead regular review of program effectiveness and implement evidence-informed changes based on assessment findings.
  
  
Maintain accurate and complete program records, policies, procedures, and accreditation documentation.
  
  
Ensure that program information published for students and the public is accurate, current, and consistent with institutional and accreditation requirements.
  
  
Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance
  
  
Maintain continuous compliance with current CAATE Standards for Accreditation of Professional Athletic Training Programs.
  
  
Serve as the primary institutional contact for CAATE.
  
  
Prepare and submit required annual reports, self-studies, progress reports, substantive-change requests, and other accreditation documentation.
  
  
Lead preparations for accreditation reviews and site visits.
  
  
Monitor regulatory, accreditation, certification, and professional developments affecting athletic training education.
  
  
Communicate accreditation expectations clearly to faculty, staff, students, administrators, and clinical partners.
  
  
Maintain continuous accreditation readiness and promptly address identified areas of concern or noncompliance.
  
  
Curriculum and Instruction
  
  
Lead the design, delivery, assessment, and continuous improvement of the athletic training curriculum.
  
  
Ensure that the curriculum reflects contemporary athletic training practice, professional standards, evidence-informed care, and evolving healthcare needs.
  
  
Coordinate the sequencing and integration of didactic, laboratory, simulation, clinical, and interprofessional learning experiences.
  
  
Ensure that course content, instructional methods, and assessment strategies support achievement of program learning outcomes and professional competencies.
  
  
Verify that faculty teaching assignments are aligned with faculty qualifications and areas of expertise.
  
  
Promote effective use of simulation, educational technology, clinical reasoning, and active learning.
  
  
Collaborate with faculty to identify and address curricular gaps, unnecessary duplication, and emerging content needs.
  
  
Faculty and Clinical Education Oversight
  
  
Collaborate with the Dean to ensure that the program has sufficient qualified core and associated faculty.
  
  
Provide orientation, mentoring, support, and evaluation for program faculty.
  
  
Work closely with the Coordinator of Clinical Education to ensure the quality, sufficiency, diversity, and effectiveness of clinical education experiences.
  
  
Ensure that clinical sites and preceptors meet institutional and accreditation expectations.
  
  
Promote effective communication and collaboration among faculty, clinical preceptors, students, and clinical partners.
  
  
Monitor faculty workload and advocate for the resources needed to meet program responsibilities.
  
  
Student Recruitment, Progression, and Outcomes
  
  
Collaborate with admissions and enrollment colleagues to recruit and enroll qualified students.
  
  
Ensure that admission, progression, retention, remediation, and dismissal policies are clearly communicated and consistently applied.
  
  
Monitor student academic and clinical performance and coordinate appropriate academic support and remediation.
  
  
Promote student professional development, ethical practice, leadership, and readiness for contemporary clinical practice.
  
  
Monitor graduation, employment, retention, and Board of Certification examination outcomes.
  
  
Use student and graduate outcomes to guide program evaluation and continuous improvement.
  
  
Maintain mechanisms for receiving and responding to student feedback and concerns.
  
  
Clinical and Professional Partnerships
  
  
Develop and maintain relationships with healthcare systems, schools, colleges and universities, sports organizations, rehabilitation facilities, physician practices, community organizations, and other clinical partners.
  
  
Expand access to high-quality clinical education experiences representing varied patient populations, settings, and levels of care.
  
  
Promote faculty and student engagement in professional organizations and community initiatives.
  
  
Represent the program in state and national athletic training education and professional forums.
  
  
Support partnerships that enhance student learning, faculty scholarship, workforce development, and community impact.

**Job Description**

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess:

Doctoral degree from an accredited institution.

Eligibility for faculty appointment at the rank of associate professor or professor at Thomas Jefferson University.

Current certification and good standing as an athletic trainer through the Board of Certification.

Eligibility for athletic trainer licensure in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.

A minimum of three years of full-time teaching or comparable academic experience in athletic training education or a closely related field.

Knowledge of exercise science education and related professional standards or certifications.

A record of progressive academic leadership, such as service as a department chair, program director, associate or assistant program director, clinical education coordinator, or comparable academic administrator.

Demonstrated knowledge of CAATE accreditation standards, policies, and reporting requirements.

Experience with curriculum development, program assessment, student-learning assessment, and continuous quality improvement.

Demonstrated ability to lead faculty, staff, students, and clinical partners in a collaborative academic environment.

Experience managing personnel, budgets, resources, and competing priorities.

A record of teaching, scholarship, service, clinical practice, or professional accomplishment appropriate to the proposed faculty rank and track.

Strong written, oral, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills.

Evidence of sound judgment, integrity, transparency, and effective decision-making.

A demonstrated commitment to academic excellence, student success, collegiality, and inclusive educational environments.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
The strongest candidates will demonstrate several of the following:
  
  
Prior experience as a department chair and/or director of a CAATE-accredited professional athletic training program.

Significant experience preparing CAATE reports, self-studies, substantive-change requests, and accreditation review materials.

Experience overseeing both undergraduate and graduate academic programs.

Experience administering accelerated, direct-entry, or articulated academic pathways.

A sustained record of scholarship and professional recognition appropriate for appointment at the rank of associate professor or professor.

Demonstrated success recruiting, mentoring, evaluating, and retaining faculty and staff.

Experience using enrollment, financial, accreditation, and performance data to guide decision-making.

Demonstrated success in strategic planning, program development, organizational change, and implementation.

Experience strengthening Board of Certification examination performance and other student outcomes.

Evidence of successful interdisciplinary, interprofessional, clinical, community, or industry partnerships.

Experience securing external funding, developing revenue-generating initiatives, or supporting philanthropic activity.

Leadership experience in state or national professional, accreditation, certification, or educational organizations.

Familiarity with academic health systems, comprehensive universities, or multi-campus educational environments.

Experience advancing simulation, technology-enhanced learning, human-performance assessment, sports science, or clinical innovation.
  
  
Leadership Attributes
  
  
The successful candidate will be:
  
  
A strategic and systems-oriented thinker who can connect departmental priorities with broader College and University goals.

An accessible, transparent, and collaborative academic leader.

A strong advocate for students, faculty, staff, academic quality, and professional education.

An effective listener who values diverse perspectives and builds productive consensus.

A decisive administrator who addresses complex issues directly, fairly, and constructively.

A mentor who develops faculty, strengthens teams, and supports emerging leaders.

A responsible steward of financial, physical, human, and technological resources.

A leader who balances innovation and growth with quality, sustainability, and accreditation compliance.

A visible and credible representative of exercise science, athletic training education, and the Department.
  
  
Department and Institutional Context
  
  
The Department of Exercise Science is housed within the Jefferson College of Rehabilitation Sciences. Its educational offerings include the Bachelor of Science in Exercise Science, accelerated pathways connecting exercise science with professional programs in athletic training, physical therapy, and occupational therapy.

Exercise science students receive classroom, laboratory, and applied learning experiences that prepare them for employment and advanced study in areas such as health and fitness, strength and conditioning, human performance, exercise physiology, cardiac rehabilitation, wellness, and sport science.

The professional athletic training program prepares graduates for eligibility to sit for the Board of Certification examination and enter the profession of athletic training. The combined Chair and Program Director will have the opportunity to strengthen the integration of exercise science and athletic training education, expand interdisciplinary partnerships, enhance student outcomes, and shape the Department’s next phase of academic, clinical, and scholarly development.
  
  
Appointment

This is a full-time, 12-month academic and administrative appointment. Faculty rank and track will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, academic record, and alignment with Thomas Jefferson University appointment criteria.

The allocation of effort between department-chair responsibilities, athletic training program-director responsibilities, teaching, scholarship, and service will be established in consultation with the Dean and reviewed periodically to ensure sufficient time and support for both leadership roles.

Thomas Jefferson University is committed to providing equal educational and employment opportunities without discrimination and seeks candidates whose experiences and leadership will contribute to an inclusive, collaborative, and academically excellent community.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Title:** ***Service Project Coordinator***

**Working Pattern:** ***Full Time***

**Working location:** ***Lockport, Louisiana***

*Relocation assistance is not available for this position.*

  

**Why Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

  

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.

  

You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is **Infinite Potential** . And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.

  

**Position Summary**

*The Service Project Coordinator supports the execution of large-engine service projects by coordinating warranty activities, financial reporting, project administration, invoicing, and government contract requirements. This role serves as a key partner to Service Managers, Finance, and operational teams to ensure projects are executed efficiently, customer commitments are fulfilled, and financial performance is accurately tracked. Through strong coordination and operational oversight, the position contributes directly to service excellence and business performance across the Large Engine Services organization. The individual in this role will be required to be onsite on a hybrid basis at the customer location in Lockport, Louisiana to focus on assisting technicians, reporting, and monitoring job progression on the customer site.*

  

**What you will be doing**

* *Coordinate the administrative and financial execution of large-engine service projects, including labor tracking, invoicing, quotations, purchase requests, parts management, tooling records, and project documentation.*

* *Manage warranty and work-in-progress activities by tracking claims, supporting failure analysis processes, monitoring open items, and partnering with internal stakeholders to drive timely resolution.*

* *Analyze project financial data, revenue projections, and controlling reports, providing visibility and support for operational decision-making and project performance improvements.*

* *Support government contracts and customer projects by coordinating documentation, invoice submissions, records management, and compliance with applicable customer and contractual requirements.*

* *Partner with Service Managers, Engineering, Finance, and global stakeholders to coordinate corrective actions, improve service execution processes, and support successful project delivery.*

* *Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% of the time to customer sites located around the globe and US Coast Guard Bases. This position will be located in Lockport, Louisiana when travel is not required.*

  

**Basic Requirements:**

* *Associate's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field and at least 3 years of experience in service project coordination, project administration, customer support, warranty administration, or a related field; OR*

* *Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field and at least 1 year of experience in service project coordination, project administration, customer support, warranty administration, or a related field; OR*

* *Master's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field; OR*

* *JD/PhD in Business, Engineering Technology; OR*

* *At least 5 years of relevant experience in service project coordination, project administration, customer support, warranty administration in lieu of a degree.*

* *In order to be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent. Resident Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

  

**Preferred Requirements:**

* *Demonstrated experience supporting service projects involving internal combustion engines, marine equipment, power generation systems, or heavy industrial equipment.*

* *Working knowledge of warranty administration, government contracts, work-in-progress management, project financial reporting, and service operations.*

* *Experience utilizing SAP and related business systems, including MS5, PAS, C4S, PS3, or similar ERP, service, and project-management platforms.*

* *Strong analytical, organizational, and stakeholder-management capabilities, with experience coordinating complex projects involving multiple internal teams, suppliers, customers, or subcontractors.*

  

**Mental & Physical Requirements:**

* *Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.*

* Ability to work at heights, climb ladders, and enter confined spaces as required by field service tasks.

* *Ability to sit, stand, bend, stoop, walk, lift, and use a keyboard or mouse as required to perform the position.*

* *Ability to work time in marine shipyards and vessel engine rooms in an office environment.*

* *Ability to work near moving mechanical equipment and in environments that may include elevated noise, fumes, dust, water, odors, gases, heat, cold, and humidity.*

* *Ability to work a non-traditional schedule and extended hours while performing field-service assignments.*

BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION & GROWTH ASSISTANT

**Terry Tech Mechanical Services**

Position Overview

Terry Tech Mechanical Services is seeking a motivated, organized, professional, and proactive individual to support the company's daily business operations, administration, customer service, and continued growth.

This is **more than a receptionist position**. The person in this role will play an important part in keeping Terry Tech organized and operating efficiently. Responsibilities will include answering phone calls, managing the Terry Tech business email, organizing customer information, coordinating with technicians, preparing invoices, researching and ordering parts, writing and preparing contracts for new business, managing company vehicle registrations, assisting with marketing, and helping identify new business opportunities.

The ideal candidate will be someone who takes initiative, stays organized, communicates professionally, and is willing to take responsibility for multiple areas of the business.

Primary ResponsibilitiesOffice Administration & Daily Operations

* Answer incoming phone calls professionally and assist customers with their questions and requests.
* Manage the Terry Tech Mechanical Services business email.
* Respond to customers, vendors, suppliers, technicians, and business contacts in a professional and timely manner.
* Organize work orders, service records, customer information, paperwork, contracts, and other company documents.
* Process completed technician paperwork and assist with preparing and sending invoices.
* Assist with QuickBooks, billing records, estimates, and proposals.
* Assist with scheduling and coordinating service calls.
* Follow up on open work orders, customer requests, estimates, invoices, and paperwork.
* Help keep the office and administrative side of the business organized and running smoothly.

Customer & Contact Database Management

* Create and maintain an organized spreadsheet or database containing all Terry Tech customers and business contacts.
* Maintain accurate customer names, company names, phone numbers, email addresses, addresses, and other important contact information.
* Keep customer and vendor information updated.
* Add new customers, potential customers, vendors, suppliers, property managers, and other business contacts to the database.
* Organize contact information so it can be easily searched and accessed when needed.
* Maintain a useful customer database for future communication, marketing, follow-up, and business development.
* Keep records organized so Terry Tech can easily identify existing customers and potential new customers.

Parts Research & Ordering

* Research and identify the correct parts needed for service and repair work.
* Look up parts using equipment model numbers, serial numbers, manufacturer information, parts diagrams, catalogs, and supplier resources.
* Research parts availability, pricing, specifications, and lead times.
* Order parts and supplies when requested by management or technicians.
* Communicate with suppliers and vendors regarding parts, pricing, availability, shipping, and delivery.
* Keep records of parts that have been ordered.
* Follow up on outstanding parts orders and delivery dates.
* Help ensure technicians receive the correct parts needed to complete repairs and service work.

Contract & Proposal Preparation

* Assist with writing and preparing contracts for new customers and new business opportunities.
* Prepare preventative maintenance agreements and service agreements.
* Assist with preparing professional proposals, estimates, and other business documents.
* Organize contract information, customer information, scope of work, pricing information, and other required details.
* Maintain organized records of active contracts.
* Track contract renewal dates and follow up when contracts are approaching expiration.
* Assist Terry Tech management with preparing documents for commercial, institutional, government, and other potential customers.

Technician Coordination

* Communicate with technicians regarding schedules, work orders, parts, customer information, and job requirements.
* Help coordinate technicians and make sure they have the information needed for scheduled service calls.
* Follow up with technicians regarding completed work orders and required paperwork.
* Help identify missing information or documentation needed to complete an invoice or customer file.
* Communicate important customer or job information to the appropriate technician or management.

Customer Service & Communication

* Answer incoming phone calls.
* Manage and organize the Terry Tech business email.
* Communicate professionally with customers and business contacts.
* Assist customers with scheduling, estimates, invoices, contracts, and service follow-ups.
* Maintain professional communication with vendors, suppliers, property managers, technicians, and business partners.
* Make follow-up calls and send follow-up emails when necessary.

Vehicle & Fleet Administration

* Be responsible for keeping company vehicle registrations organized and up to date.
* Coordinate the registration and renewal of **every Terry Tech van and company vehicle that requires registration**.
* Maintain records of vehicle registrations, tags, renewal dates, and related documentation.
* Coordinate DMV-related administrative requirements for company vehicles.
* Monitor registration and renewal deadlines.
* Notify management when vehicle registrations, tags, inspections, or other vehicle documentation require attention.

Marketing & Business Promotion

* Help maintain the company's online presence and website information.

University of Colorado Medicine (CU Medicine) is the region's largest and most comprehensive multispecialty physician group practice. At our primary and specialty care clinics across the Denver metro area and Front Range, CU Anschutz School of Medicine physicians and advanced practice providers bring the latest medical knowledge and new advancements to the care they provide every day. CU Medicine also provides business operations, revenue cycle and administrative services to support the patients of CU Anschutz School of Medicine providers.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Patient Scheduler to join our Cardiothoracic Surgery team.
  
  
This job can be performed 100% remotely. Preference may be given to applicants residing in Colorado, but out of state candidates will be considered.
  
  
Under general supervision, the Patient Scheduler performs a broad range of non-clinical scheduling and administrative functions in support of clinic operations throughout the Denver metro area. This role is responsible for managing incoming and outgoing calls, routing inquiries appropriately, registering new patients, scheduling clinic appointments, retrieving medical records, managing referral work queues, reviewing and responding to Epic In-Basket messages, processing provider scheduling requests, and maintaining accurate documentation. The Patient Scheduler serves as a primary point of contact for patients, providers, referring offices, and clinic teams, supporting efficient scheduling workflows, timely communication, and a high standard of customer service within the clinical environment. This position functions strictly in a non-clinical capacity and does not communicate clinical information such as diagnoses, test results, or post-operative care instructions. All clinical inquiries are directed to appropriate nursing or provider staff.
  
  
**Essential Duties:**  

* Manage inbound and outbound telephone calls, gather essential information, and route callers to the appropriate clinical or administrative team while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality.
* Schedule clinic appointments accurately in Epic, selecting correct visit types, providers, and locations across multiple clinics throughout the Denver metro area.
* Independently manage referral work queues, including reviewing new referrals, verifying required documentation, and scheduling patients according to DOS guidelines.
* Review and complete Epic in-basket messages for non-clinical requests such as scheduling, documentation updates, and administrative follow-up while routing clinical concerns to the appropriate RN/APP/provider.
* Manage provider-initiated scheduling requests for specific patients sent through Epic in-basket or other communication from providers or clinic teams, ensuring timely and accurate appointment placement.
* Retrieve, upload, and route medical records, imaging, and supporting documentation to ensure providers have the information required for upcoming appointments.
* Monitor and process incoming faxes, upload documents into the correct Epic encounter, and route items to the appropriate clinical or administrative team.
* Attend DOS huddles, meetings, and scheduled trainings to remain informed of workflow changes, best practices, scheduling updates, and department-wide communication.

**Requirements:**  

* High school diploma or equivalent; 2 years of experience in a healthcare setting preferred.
* Experience with Epic or comparable electronic medical record systems preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with professional telephone etiquette.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills with the ability to work with diverse patient populations.
* Ability to multitask, adapt to shifting priorities, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of medical terminology and front-office functions preferred.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA requirements.

All applications MUST be submitted via our website. In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

3e80f0e89eb476ea8fe1.description:
**OUR MISSION**

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person’s cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help care teams focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you’re inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what’s possible, we’d love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

In this role, you will directly support training and enablement for the Enrollment Team, which serves as the first point of contact for prospective members, guiding them through the enrollment process with compassion and clarity. Enrollment Specialists conduct high-volume outreach to members via phone, email, and text to educate patients about Thyme Care’s oncology navigation services and enroll them into the program. Enrollment Specialists verify eligibility and insurance, ensure accurate documentation, and coordinate timely handoffs to clinical teams. Enrollment Specialists maintain a strong understanding of Thyme Care’s mission and services to clearly communicate value to patients and caregivers.

This position will play a fundamental role in developing and maintaining the standards of quality and training that Thyme Care strives to meet by ensuring that new hires and existing Enrollment team members receive the training and coaching to be successful in their roles. This position also plays a key part in partnering with the Quality team to discover trends and training needs to inform better enablement materials and coaching areas for the enrollment of the Care Team. This role reports into the Team Lead, Education & Enablement for the Enrollment Team.

* Your primary responsibilities will include developing training content (for both virtual sessions and live sessions), facilitating live training sessions, and managing the administrative and operational logistics of training so that everything happens smoothly and efficiently.
* You will also be responsible for creating training materials, training resources, and job aids, to ensure all team members have the information they need to do their jobs effectively and efficiently, and to stay up to date with new product updates and releases, changes in workflows and processes, and new client launches.
* Your focus will be on meeting the training needs of Thyme Care’s Enrollment Team, including both new team member onboarding and continuing education.
* You will keep track of team members’ training modules completion, progress, and understanding by listening to interactions with members and assessing them against our quality standards.
* You will also attend regular QA calibration sessions to identify opportunities for new or improved training materials and sessions, and schedule additional time as needed to align on priorities and next steps.

**WHAT YOU’VE DONE**

**Experience & Education**

* 2+ years experience in training delivery or staff development, developing and delivering both virtual instructor-led training, and self-paced module programs.
* Experience working in a fast-paced, startup environment.
* Bachelor's Degree.
* Certified Professional in Training Management (CPTM) or similar training certification is ideal but not required.
* Knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare compliance standards is a plus but not required.

**Required Skills**

* **Excellent communication and presentation skills** (both written and verbal), including public speaking and facilitation.
* **Strong tech skills** and ability to learn new tools quickly and autonomously.
* **Ability to build high quality, polished training materials** including presentation slides and written job aids.
* **Comfort with data**, and ability to both manipulate and analyze data to evaluate training effectiveness using metrics and dashboards.
* **Exceptional project management** skills and ability to coordinate multiple training initiatives simultaneously.
* **High attention to detail** and organizational skills.
* **Proficiency with Google Suite, Zoom and Slack**.

**Additional Skills**

* Understanding of healthcare terminology, patient enrollment workflows, and call center/customer service operations preferred.
* Experience in using and building in a Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Captivate, etc.) preferred.
* Proficiency in adult instruction, time and classroom management, and adapting to diverse learning needs preferred.

**WHAT LEADS TO SUCCESS**

**Expertise**. You have experience facilitating and building staff training, with a well-developed instinct for how to build engaging training and clear materials that drive staff proficiency and success.

**Collaborative approach**. You can seamlessly collaborate with cross-functional teams including Enrollment Management and Team Leads, as well as HR, Compliance, Operations, and IT.

**A patient-first approach**. You’re personally motivated by our mission and by what we are building. You seek to understand problems and help people solve them, especially this one.

**Operational orientation.** Creating and improving processes is second nature for you. You build repeatable, reliable, and efficient processes and are able to train others accordingly.

**Move with purpose.** You’re biased to action. You know how to identify and prioritize your initiative’s needs and do what it takes to ensure that urgent and important needs are acted on immediately.

**Effective listener and communicator**. You are persuasive and articulate, but you always start by listening. You build rapport, trust, and great working relationships with colleagues.

**Bias to action**. You’re a self-starter and don’t need anyone to tell you when to do something. You’re always solving problems and going the extra mile for others.

**OUR VALUES**  
*At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we choose—or don’t choose.*

*This is a non-exempt, full time position. The pay rate for this role is $28.85 per hour. To perform this role you must be located within the lower 48 United States due to contractual limitations with accessing PHIs. We offer a choice of great medical, dental, and vision insurance plans as well as a generous vacation policy for full-time employees, so you can prioritize the most important parts of your life.*

*We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. We’re here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.*

*Be cautious of**recruitment fraud**, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.*

* Competitive salary with benefits

* Medical, dental, vision & 401(k)

* Mission-driven healthcare organization improving patient outcomes through DME solutions

The Therapy Coordinator Regional Administrator is responsible for tracking and resolving all patient cases assigned to Therapy Coordinators within assigned regions. This role ensures timely case acceptance, accurate documentation, and appropriate scheduling of patient visits. The Regional Administrator collaborates with internal teams to support order completion, maintain compliance, and provide guidance on home visit protocols and equipment. This is a full-time position with Monday through Friday hours.

* Monitor processes to ensure timely acceptance of patient cases by Therapy Coordinators
* Ensure all necessary medical documentation is received accurately and in a timely manner
* Assist with assigning and reassigning patient cases as needed
* Review patient cases and follow up on outstanding or unscheduled cases
* Verify Therapy Coordinator work hours and patient visit activity
* Provide approval for off-cycle patient home visits on a case-by-case basis
* Assist with training and education related to home visit protocols and equipment
* Collaborate with internal operations teams to support order completion and documentation accuracy
* Identify, escalate, and communicate patient questions, concerns, or needs to the Patient Relations team
* Maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements, including HIPAA and company policies
* Travel as needed to support regional and operational needs
* Support and participate in company-wide initiatives and training programs
* Collaborate effectively with team members, departments, and leadership
* Uphold company Mission, Vision, and Values in all interactions and responsibilities
* Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* Customer relationship and product education/training experience.
* 2-5 years of experience successfully managing a small team required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills,
* Proven organizational and time management skills,
* Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks,
* Knowledgeable with technology, including but not limited to scheduling, travel and documentation applications and software.
* Self-motivated and self-disciplined; ability to effectively work independently and meet expectations of the role.
* Ability to work with multiple departments to collaboratively facilitate solutions.
* Prior administrative experience preferred but not required.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams)
* DME experience preferred but not required.
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred but not required.

**SUPERVISORY FUNCTIONS**  

* This position has no supervisory responsibilities

**ABOUT LYMPHA PRESS**

Lympha Press helps people with lymphedema, venous disease, and lipedema improve their quality of life through innovative pneumatic compression therapy systems. MatrixCare provides software solutions to more than 15,000 providers supporting skilled nursing, senior living and long-term care, life plan communities, and home health and hospice care. We are looking for a Vice President, Customer Support to join our customer organization and lead the transformation of Support across MatrixCare's portfolio of post-acute care solutions. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, you will lead the move to an AI-first Support model, embedding AI, automation, intelligent self-service, and knowledge throughout the support experience so teams can focus their expertise on complex customer needs where human judgment matters most. Our customers rely on MatrixCare technology for critical clinical, financial, regulatory, and operational workflows every day. We are seeking a leader who combines technology, operational excellence, healthcare industry knowledge, and deep human expertise to improve customer satisfaction, accelerate resolution, and build the Support organization of the future.

* Develop and execute a Support strategy and operating model that improves consistency, scalability, productivity, and customer experience across products and customer segments.

* 7+ years leading large, geographically distributed Support organizations and teams of leaders.
